# Copilot instructions

Copilot reads this file from the Git root of `code-to-video`.

Follow `AGENTS.md` for framework rules, validation, and approvals. When `../development-control/RESUME.md` exists, read it before choosing a task. That sibling is outside this repository. When it is absent, use `docs/ROADMAP.md` only.

Work on one authorized milestone. Keep TypeScript strict and Remotion animation deterministic. Do not add dependencies without a stated need. Do not start proposed milestones. Do not treat a passing test as human approval, and do not replace visual baselines unless the user asks for that command.
